reviews.review: I'm gonna assert my dominance by saying I beat this game first try on my first playthrough somehow, in 2.8 hours of playtime.

im unsure if this is a popular opinion or not, but i think i might prefer this over ror2

it feels as though power is more based on your character and loadout than what items you get. while items are useful, i dont enjoy leaving most of my run up to rng.

i also prefer the 2d setting, making melee survivors more enjoyable to play (and wisps less annoying).

also it has enforcer
if only the risk of rain 2 engi Returns™

An updated version of the original Risk of Rain for modern audiences of Risk of Rain 2, that is what Risk of Rain Returns is, and it does a stellar job of keeping the look of the original game whilst being sleek and refined and I believe it is the best way to experience Risk of Rain at this given moment. 

Risk Returns is a very difficult game. More so than 2 or even the original at points. The pool of items is so vastly diluted with a bunch of rubbish pickups yet sometimes you find an item and go "hey why does this remind me of sonorous whispers on launch of Sots?" in terms of how broken it can be. A few items can be absolute run savers and others just detriments from them appearing. Its a problem with the original that they attempted to rectify by adding overpowered items into the pool so when you get a good item it feels like its a won run. Don't think its exactly too easy though because this game gets difficult fast. You have to adopt a bit of a speedy mindset running this game unlike 2. As most enemies are beefy, can be devestating elites, or spawn in droves at once. Along with the fact that this games hitboxes barely seem fair it leaves any new sod a very ruined carcass by the end of it. I powered through though because at the end of the day I enjoy the gameplay loop.  

The survivor cast is fine. I'm not entirely as fond of the survivors in here as opposed to RoR2, but that's also accounting for 2's accessability. Commando especially is SEVERELY underpowered without the right items, it takes getting used to but he feels really weak, granted the alt skills do make him tolerable and dare I say fun. But his primary is INSANELY bad without just specing into pure attack speed. The new survivors they added Pilot and Drifter are insanely broken and busted for this type of game. Especially Drifter. Oh my god Drifter. (Congrats on making it to RoR2 Alloyed Collective!) Oh yeah and they added Alt Skills something RoR (2013) did not have which are gained through special tasks. (Yes including some annoying ones like kill final boss while __ ) Or they are attained via Providence Trials. These are for the most part quite nice! Apart from the ones which make you go through hell to unlock only to be insanely abysmal. I'm looking at you Sniper Alt Utility.

Speaking of Providence Trials. I really like them for the most part. I like the ones that feel like a puzzle to be solved or a speedrun. However there are some glaring issues and that resides solely on the fact that I believe a lot of them are just monotonous. Kill X amount of Enemies before X or Survive for X amount of time can only be rehashed and redone so many times before I believe it becomes a drag. The rewards for some are great others are voltaic mitt. (Atleast you got a buff) And all of these trials have a somewhat optional ability to be golded basically go above the original goal. I think some of these are fine meanwhile others are Drowning in Research taking 135 points when it becomes borderline luck near the end to beat it. Other than that these are a welcome addition. I'd honestly like smn like this for RoR2 but that's a pipe dream and a half. 

The art is fantastic from the sprites to the music by Chris yet again. The monster logs and the survivor entries are really well done and I think the style was knocked out of the park with this game. Its what I think gives it a lot of charm for me honestly. 

I recommend this game to anyone who can stomach some difficulty or if they are wanting to play with friends who have returns and are willing to give it an honest shot, some might be turned off by this games inate difficulty from translating from the original but if you wanna experience the original just play this game instead. (Oh yeah can we please buff Arti again. Just make her immune whilst using Flamethrower) 

8.7/10
